description: Are you looking for a family apartment near the beach and everything in Rincón, Puerto Rico? This is for you. Comfortable place with a pool. Just at the exit of the center of town and at the main road crossing to the beach. Nearby world famous surf beaches. Convenient location. Within walking distance from the plaza, supermarkets, bakeries, shops, restaurants and food truck parks. Steps away from hotels, bars, banks, churches and others. Fully renovated and private parking. We want to serve you.The spaceWant to be all together in one place! With family and friends! We have the perfect place for you. The Blue Breeze Rincón Apartments complex just for yourselves. You will be able to enjoy 4 individual apartments within the same location, a pool, recreational area and a Pergola with additional sitting area, domino table and other table games. With a general capacity for up to 16 guests: apartment #1 with 2 bedrooms, 3 queen beds, 2 full bathrooms, living room, 2 televisions (1 in each common area) , dining room, kitchen and balcony; Apt. #2 - One bedroom with a queen bed and direct access to a full bathroom, TV and work desk. Kitchen-dining area and sofa with TV; Apts. #3: On the first floor you'll find the Kitchen-dining area and coffe station, one bedroom with a queen bed and a full bathroom. On the second floor you'll find the loft with a queen bed, and interior balcony with direct pool view. Apt. # 3 & 4 are exactly the same.All apartments include a retro gaming console. Where located within a very short walking distance from beaches, restaurants, shops, supermarkets, bakeries, wide variety Food Trucks, the town's main hotels, activities like the Art Gallery Thursdays in the Public Plaza, churches and much more. Backup Power Generator. Reserve with time.Guest accessEntire building, pool and recreational area and private parking.

title: Simple seaside cottage, direct beach access Rincón
description: Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway.The spaceUnique seaside cottage with spectacular direct ocean views, private beach access on the property (right in front of the home) and secure guest parking in beautiful Rincón, Puerto Rico! Enjoy sunbathing, swimming, snorkeling, whale watching, star gazing, and live authentically like a local. This charming and cozy home features stunning views, and exotic local wildlife. You’ll spot iguanas, abundant marine life, and many different types of tropical birds and plants.Enjoy this mesmerizing Rincón beach house with unparalleled ocean front access and views. Sun-filled, cozy 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom bungalow directly on the ocean with private guest access, parking, fully equipped kitchen, and ample indoor and outdoor living spaces.Guest accessGuests have full access to this private cottage, including one parking space and their own private oceanfront patio, open space side yard and beach entry. Of note, when arriving, guests must walk BEHIND and AROUND another small residence (with a wooden deck) to access this rental home. There are a few stairs to descend and climb along the way. Guests must NOT walk across the private, wooden deck in front of the adjacent home as this belongs to another owner and is private. Contact Carlo for any questions.Guests have full and complete access to this private home nestled by the seashore. Please note, there is an adjacent, private cottage also located on the frontside of the property, and each home has private, ocean-facing decks, reserved parking onsite, and different beach access points. Guests accessing this cottage enter by going down and behind the first and front cottage so as not to interrupt or disturb the residents’ enjoyment of the private deck or ocean views. Additionally, this home has privacy deck screens and window shades for an added level of comfort and peace.Other things to noteProperty & AccessibilitySome stairs must be used to access both this cottage and arrive at the beach. There is no lifeguard on duty. Guests should use good judgement and common sense when exploring the shoreline and swimming in the ocean waters. Guests swim, snorkel and paddle board at their own risk and assume the liability of any ocean activities. This property is not recommended for infants, children or adults requiring supervision with water as there are many access points to the ocean and areas to slip and fall, and it may pose a risk of injury, drowning etc. Guests are responsible for their own equipment and their own safety when enjoying the ocean. In order to respect the delicate marine ecosystem and others swimming in the waters, fishing is discouraged.CancellationsWe understand that life happens. As a small business providing local employment, we hope that you understand our need to maintain a consistent cancellationpolicy. We recommend purchasing trip insurance that covers expenses from last-minute cancellations of lodging and transportation due to theft, medical, etc. Airbnb and Travel Guard offer affordable options to ensure you're covered in the event of the unexpected.PestsPlease note that since we are located on a tropical island, from time to time you may see a dead bug or two in the cottage, especially with warmer and warmer temperatures. This is normal, to be expected and cannot be avoided. Doors should remain closed when possible to minimize pests (i.e. when loading/unloading the car, taking out the trash or hanging out on the porch). Bugs can get inside easily, especially in warmer weather. The cottage is treated inside & out by a pest control company for your comfort and safety.We stay on top of this costly pest control so please help us keep it effective - thank you!Local AnimalsWe love animals and rescued a Puerto Rican “sato” (stray dog), however we kindly ask that you do not feed any stray cats or dogs that are encountered in and around the property. If you feed them they stay and persistently seek more food which becomes difficult and uncomfortable for us as hosts and for other guests, especially those with severe allergies to animals. Let us know if you’d like to rescue a dog or cat, and we can help you!

description: Welcome to our tropical oasis! Spacious townhome with everything you need for a relaxing vacation. Enjoy the outdoor living space on the rooftop terrace with a hammock, BBQ, and outdoor sitting areas. Board games, WiFi, and cable are also provided for your entertainment. Laundry room with washer and dryer. You'll stay cool and comfortable with A/C in the living room and all bedrooms. Master bedroom boasts a king-size bed and a bathroom, 2nd and 3rd bedrooms have queen beds and a shared bath.The spaceWe're just a short walk from the beach but located in a quiet area away from the noise of the nightlife. The street to the beach is flat, so no need to navigate steep hills. Beach chairs are provided for your convenience. Our townhome offers 2306 square feet of living space and is located in a gated community. You can also take advantage of shared swimming pool and clubhouse facilities, as well as three parking spaces.Guest accessOur gated community also has a swimming pool and outdoor gazebo area with bathrooms and an outdoor shower.Other things to notePlease remember that this is a vacation home, not a hotel. Please treat the space with respect and let us know if any issues arise during your stay and we will do our best to address them promptly. We do not supply extra toiletries, so please plan accordingly. Come relax and unwind in paradise at our tropical oasis townhome. We can't wait to welcome you!

title: Maria's Luxury Villa
description: Maria's Luxury Villa is an exclusive 8-bedroom gated, oceanfront villa located on Maria’s Beach in Rincon. Enjoy our beautiful estate with its complete range of features, such as high-speed internet, parking and cable TVs. Enjoy the swimming pool or go to the beach through our private access. Our fully furnished villa offers all the comforts of home, as well as daily maid service, concierge services, and much more! You will be welcomed with a platter of fresh local fruit and Puerto Rican rum.The spaceThe entire property is for use at Maria's. We have 8 bedrooms, 2 full size kitchens, and 2 full living rooms. However, most guests make use of the spacious outdoor living soace enjoying 2 hot tubs and 2 propane grills. The full size swimming pool offers privacy from the beach but the convenience of surfing the waves then jumping directly into the pool. This property is one of the premier properties in Rincón.Guest accessFull accessOther things to noteWe offer a full size generator and plenty of back up water if we experience any power or water outages. We have Starlink internet and daily staff to assist with any requests or issues.
